info.title: Wheelwright API v2
info.description:
Wheelwright maintains provenance-bearing evidence for options-income decision support. API v2 exposes domain resources independently of any browser or CLI.

**Last publication:** not published — local preview. **Preview date:** 2026-10-22.

# Getting started

1. Choose a resource from the navigation. Each operation shows its method, stable operation ID, parameters, schemas, status codes and examples.
2. Inspect the request and the response together. A completed HTTP request does not establish fresh evidence, successful processing, or complete brokerage history.
3. Use the copyable cURL example as a request-shape template. Every example uses invented data and the reserved, nonworking `api.example.invalid` origin. This reference never sends API requests.

A published capability describes the API; operational actions require a separately commissioned task. Reading examples does not start an operation.

Account and User IDs are opaque backend identities; Account aliases are display/discovery metadata. Copy existing resource identities rather than constructing them from broker account numbers. Empty collections are meaningful results, distinct from unavailable evidence.

# Reading evidence correctly

- **Acquire or revalidate:** `POST /v2/quotes` evaluates reuse or performs bounded acquisition. HTTP 200 contains independent per-subject outcomes; a retained prior observation does not fulfill a failed acquisition. FORCE may cause another upstream attempt and correlation does not deduplicate it.
- **Read held quotes:** both quote GET operations return retained committed evidence without provider contact or freshness/reuse evaluation. They do not turn old evidence into current evidence. Discovery is complete per committed item, without a collection-wide atomic instant.
- **Read Positions:** GET reads independently identified economic Positions, their current Construction and evidence-qualified evaluation. Each Position has its own Wheelwright GUID; CLOSED is terminal and a subsequent opening requires a new GUID. A repeated holdings observation does not prove uninterrupted economic continuity, an opening date or opening economics. Broker custody observations remain separately inspectable through Holdings and retained snapshots. Missing values remain unknown; date-only exports do not establish executable prices. Split/recombine policy remains unresolved.
- **Read history:** Account transaction GET may use policy-bounded backend read-through. A complete delivered collection, a complete source traversal, a coherent upstream snapshot and lifetime coverage are different claims. Lifetime coverage remains UNKNOWN; provider snapshot consistency is UNVERIFIED.
- **Retain sources:** CSV upload commits original bytes before processing. Processing REJECTED may accompany HTTP 200; inspect status and preserve earlier admitted evidence. Retry uses retained CSV bytes and does not replay brokerage acquisition.
- **Portfolio Capital:** the reported value is a qualified two-source composite, not Account NAV or an atomic brokerage observation. Unmatched or ambiguous evidence remains null.

# HTTP conventions

`X-Request-Id` correlates a request and its response; it is never an idempotency key. Receipt, commit, observation, import and evaluation clocks have different meanings. Reused or retained observations preserve original provenance and clocks.

Held v2 quote reads ignore `If-None-Match`, return 200 on success, and expose no ETag or 304. Private financial reads use `Cache-Control: private, no-store`. Quote acquisition's POST response does not promise that header. Resource-specific response headers are shown with each operation.

Errors use `application/problem+json`. The HTTP status agrees with the body status, stable code, type and title. Validation failures include nonempty `invalidParams`; header/body request IDs agree. Error samples are invented, not captured from an account.

# Glossary

| Term | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Account | Stable Wheelwright identity associated with broker-scoped external evidence. |
| Position | Independently identified Wheelwright economic resource with its own GUID, current Construction, qualified lifecycle state and financial evaluation; distinct from broker custody. |
| Holding | Account-scoped broker custody observation retained with source snapshot identity and provenance, independently of Construction recognition. |
| Artifact | Immutable original source bytes with a hash and retained processing-attempt metadata. |
| Observation | An accepted piece of evidence with its own stable identity, source and clocks. |
| Held evidence | Evidence already retained by Wheelwright, regardless of age or current reuse eligibility. |
| Provenance | Where evidence came from and when Wheelwright received and committed it. |
| Complete | A scope-specific claim; full delivery does not establish lifetime brokerage coverage. |
| Retained prior | Last successful evidence preserved after an unsuccessful reacquisition. |
| Admission | Acceptance of interpreted evidence into authoritative held state; separate from source retention. |

get.description:
Pure provider-free projection of accepted retained TASTYTRADE API_BALANCES and FIDELITY BALANCES originals. Distinct brokerField and meaning preserve cash, equity/options/day-trading buying power, margin requirements and reserve dialects. No model arithmetic establishes financial findings. currentness is always NOT_ESTABLISHED and historyCoverage UNKNOWN. Empty observations means no selected accepted balance original, never zero buying power. Original bytes remain private; only allowlisted numeric fields are projected. Missing, invalid or duplicate fields never silently become zero. Exact decimal JSON numbers retain source precision; clients must parse losslessly. Tastytrade source updated-at and snapshot-date survive separately from first artifact receipt. Fidelity export minute (America/New_York) is separate from unknown source observation time; currency is unknown and unit SOURCE_MONETARY_UNIT. Receipt ordering does not establish source-time ordering or latest/current state after trades. Collection order receivedAt then artifactId ascending; content-deduplicated originals are not a complete observation-attempt history. Select optional artifactId to narrow to an exact original. Complete collection limit 200 artifacts /32 MiB; capacity/hash failure returns 503 without partial output. Unsupported brokerage is 422. Bounded selection: selection=latest-source scans and validates originals backend-side but returns at most one observation. Source ordering uses tastytrade updated-at or Fidelity export minute, never receipt. Tied maximal source times are AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE_TIME with zero observations; all unknown clocks produce NO_ORDERABLE_SOURCE_TIME. A sourceAtOrAfter miss returns NO_MATCHING_SOURCE_TIME and the latest known retained source time. Some unknown clocks permit only a qualified maximum among known times, not a complete chronology. Currentness remains NOT_ESTABLISHED. Default all and exact artifactId reads preserve prior semantics. Financial glyphs in reportedDisplay come from validated broker scalar text; a dollar glyph does not create an ISO currency determination. Fidelity cash-account dialect also preserves exact Available to trade and Cash and credits labels; these are not aliases for Available without margin impact and do not establish Operating Regime deployable capital. Optional CSV representation is rendered by the backend from this same qualified result, never model arithmetic or raw originals. Correct currency, reported precision, fee/coverage status and source qualifications survive. USD display amounts use two decimals alongside unrounded accounting amounts in closed reports. Text cells neutralize spreadsheet formula prefixes and RFC4180 quoting preserves commas/quotes/newlines. Incomplete page/changed result is unavailable, not a partial export presented with whole-report totals.

Complete bounded JSON only; 16MiB response capacity fails with 503. No Order-state, strategy grouping or tax computation; bounded closed-trade projection is specified below. Fidelity serves retained admitted CSV activity without acquisition; row-equivalence identity does not establish a unique broker event. No-argument CLI history composes these Account-scoped resources. With mode=retained, this is a bounded provider-free query of existing admitted transaction evidence. Fidelity projection may normalize already-retained activity locally. No brokerage refresh occurs. Defaults25/max100 rows and100000 serialized bytes; capacity fails503. Exact source symbol and inclusive transaction dates are optional. Preserve all selectors and limit with nextCursor until pageComplete. Changed retained evidence invalidates the cursor422. matchedRecordCount is retained query coverage, never lifetime completeness; complete retains its existing history coverage meaning and does not imply this page is final. Source actions, reported gross value, net cash and fees remain distinct; matching a source symbol does not identify an opening cohort or associate a current construction. No premium or strategy inference. Requests without query preserve legacy read-through semantics; bounded selectors require explicit mode=retained or mode=policy. Item reads continue rejecting queries. Bounded mode also accepts order=asc|desc (default asc); reverse the existing date/execution-time/transaction-ID total order only, not a freshness or identity inference. MCP requests desc to inspect recent retained evidence first. Order is included in cursor scope and selection. First-page read-through has the existing10-second shared provider budget; subsequent pages do not refresh and changed evidence invalidates the opaque cursor. Response remains bounded100000 bytes/default25/max100 rows or whole groups. Source actions establish OPENING/CLOSING/MIXED/UNRESOLVED; buys/sells alone do not. Reversals, missing native Order identity and unknown actions cannot become confirmed exits. Reported gross transaction-value sums preserve known currency, never infer multiplier or opening basis. Coverage scan upper bound differs from observed transaction dates. Current provider path lacks verified lower bounds, so empty source results do not establish no executions. VERIFIED_TO_CUTOFF is reserved for an independently backend-established scoped coverage assertion, never inferred from first/last rows or client input.

view=closed-trades: Principal-selected reported closed-round-trip net P/L view with row outcomes and totals. Match exactly one earlier native opening package to one native closing package by native contracts, whole quantities and opposing open/close source actions. All same-contract observations must belong solely to the pair; other cohorts, adjustments/reversals, partial closes, unknown net/currency or closes spanning the period remain unavailable. This bounded method introduces no FIFO, tax-lot or governed Position identity. Opening net cash outside the report month remains in the matching basis. Sum already-net source cash once; do not subtract fees twice or assume omitted fee components are zero. Preserve QUALIFIED_ESTIMATED_FEES when the broker reports estimates or final status is unknown. Net total and winners/losers are unavailable if a returned trade cannot be reconciled or currencies conflict. The report covers matched reported closed trades, not total Account investment performance, unrealized P/L or complete lifetime/period brokerage coverage. Source histories and evidence remain available separately; no raw ledger dump is required. Optional CSV representation is rendered by the backend from this same qualified result, never model arithmetic or raw originals. Correct currency, reported precision, fee/coverage status and source qualifications survive. USD display amounts use two decimals alongside unrounded accounting amounts in closed reports. Text cells neutralize spreadsheet formula prefixes and RFC4180 quoting preserves commas/quotes/newlines. Incomplete page/changed result is unavailable, not a partial export presented with whole-report totals.

post.description:
Transactionally retain exact bytes and original filename before parsing. Same account/hash reuses generated immutable artifact identity; every upload records a filename/processing attempt. REJECTED processing is HTTP 200, source survives and prior admitted evidence remains. Positions admit snapshots. Other files admit source-row observations; History appends/matches exact row occurrences without deleting prior observations. Corrections, lifecycle projection and continuous-history coverage are unresolved. Interrupted calls may leave PENDING; inspect inventory then retry retained processing. File-type/source-period interpretations are bounded; filename account attribution is qualified when History/Balances omit account ID. Content/admission deduplicates; import-attempt identities do not. Exact mixed-account originals are retained privately. Formats without supported row-level Account attribution are retained with REJECTED processing rather than admitting mixed rows. Account relationships are in representations, not URI ancestry. Aliases are never accepted as IDs. Upload requires filename-bearing Content-Disposition and X-Brokerage-File-Type; missing or invalid upload inputs return INVALID_REQUEST/422 before retaining bytes. The body media type must be text/csv (compatible parameters are allowed).



### Supported Fidelity CSV exports

Submit existing Fidelity exports, preserving their envelope, case-sensitive column labels, account attribution and source dates. The type selects an interpretation; arbitrary CSV with similar values is not an interchangeable export. UTF-8 with an optional BOM and CSV quoting for commas, quotes and embedded newlines are supported. Required column labels describe export shape, not a requirement that every cell be nonblank.

| X-Brokerage-File-Type | Required columns | Export envelope and row rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POSITIONS | Account number; Account name; Investment type; Symbol; Description; Quantity; Current value; Total gain/loss dollar; Type | Start with the header row. Preserve the Date downloaded MMM-dd-yyyy footer and its remaining download-time text. Requested-account rows establish attribution; preserve their broker account identity. At least one requested-account row is required. Conflicting account names or truncated rows reject processing. Blank/-- quantities and Cash or missing investment types are excluded from holdings; a counted holding needs a Symbol. |
| ACTIVITY | Run Date; Action; Symbol; Amount ($) | History export with the header as the first nonblank row and original History_for_Account_{broker-account}.csv filename (supported broker download suffixes may follow the account token). Filename attribution is qualified because content omits account identity. Each data row needs a valid M/d/yyyy or M-d-yyyy Run Date and nonblank Action; Symbol may be blank. Rows must cover all header columns. Empty history can be accepted and does not establish lifetime coverage. |
| BALANCES | Balance; Day change | Balances export with the header as the first nonblank row and original Balances_for_Account_{broker-account}.csv filename (supported broker download suffixes may follow the account token). Attribution is qualified. At least one complete data row is required. Additional exported columns are retained as source observations; they do not themselves establish Portfolio Capital. |
| OPTION_SUMMARY | Symbol; Strategy; Expiration & Strike; Quantity | Preserve the opening Fidelity Investments - Option Summary {broker-account} section marker, optional Quote data as of metadata, and the subsequent header. At least one complete data row is required. Broker strategy presentation does not establish Position identity or share ownership. |

Brace-delimited account tokens above are placeholders, not example account numbers or Wheelwright accountId values. Preserve the broker-supplied filename and content instead of constructing attribution from a Wheelwright ID. Except for Positions' supported target-account row selection, unsupported mixed-account row attribution rejects processing. Preserve recognized broker footers; unknown envelopes, duplicate headers, malformed quoting or truncated data can fail processing. Balances and Option Summary retain source rows without inventing numeric or lifecycle meaning. History retains row occurrences; later normalized transaction reads apply their own date/decimal interpretation.

### Retention versus processing rejection

Missing/invalid upload headers, accountId, media type or byte size return 422 before source retention. After retention, unsupported brokerage/format, invalid UTF-8, unsupported account attribution, missing required columns/export date or malformed data produce HTTP 200 with status REJECTED and a safe result message. The source remains retained and prior admitted evidence remains intact; no partially admitted rows from the failed processing attempt become success. Inspect status, not HTTP 200 alone. A syntactically valid CSV request-shape example is not a promise of successful evidence admission. Retry reads the retained bytes and recorded filename/type; it cannot repair an incompatible source export.

get.description:

QUALIFIED denotes arithmetic inputs only, not simultaneous sides, fresh evidence or executable spreads. Source bid/ask price, displayed size and side-event clocks remain separately recorded. relatedOrders.description: Known retained peers reporting the same Account/broker/environment parent complex-order ID. brokerGroupAuthority.description: Optional source-predicate corroboration of the reported complex parent/child record against the independently retained brokerage instruction. Order.description: Observed trader instruction only; no submission, amendment, cancel or trade generation. Trigger and execution limit differ. Unfilled/expired/canceled instructions never change held exposure. Broker group ID is an attribute; preserve reconciled child Orders.

basis.description: Nonnegative magnitude of attributable original acquisition cost/premium for this owned quantity, excluding fees. Side determines cash-flow sign: LONG opening flow = -basis, SHORT = +basis. Cash balance is principal, not opening trade income. Not a tax-lot allocator.

Allocation.description: Owned allocation only. Aggregate current allocations across every Position reconcile against this source cut; historical predecessors are not current allocations. Cost-sum preservation does not establish lot attribution.

reportedBasisWholeQuantity.description: Only exact whole source holding quantities; never pro-rated allocation or opening attribution.

WholeContracts.description: Positive whole contract count. Fractional shares/cash are separate typed units.

OptionTerms.description: Standard intrinsic requires positively verified terms. Same symbol/expiry/strike/right alone does not prove equal deliverables. Adjusted terms remain visible even when payoff is unsupported. Individually missing terms remain null while known terms survive; qualification prevents standard payoff claims.

CompositionGroup.description: Finite recursive inline composition. Empty group may represent evidenced zero held exposure at closure. No cycles, duplicated ownership or invented nested Position identity. Shared subordinate economics must be referenced as relationships, not owned twice. Inline subordinate Constructions may identify an exact modelVersion without acquiring separate Position identity. Child quantities are absolute actual quantities, not another package scaling multiplier.

OtherLeaf.description: Uninterpreted supported source inventory remains visible; no standard financial payoff or named model is inferred.

FinancialRelationship.description: Aggregate economic coverage and broker-enforced reservation are different claims. This relationship references existing owned inventory; it never allocates it a second time. Distinct obligation quantities are aggregated once per coverageSetId. No tax-lot/share-to-call selection is asserted.

predecessor.description: Immediate preceding retained Construction instance when known, never a shortcut to original. Availability of intermediate instances is a source/runtime truth obligation; references must not invent a contiguous history.

predecessorStatus.description: Immediate instance association status; UNKNOWN with null predecessor never asserts a shortcut to original.

Timeline.description: Remaining days use the accepted nonnegative NY calendar convention; original days require final verified opening fill. Receipt time is never opening time. openedAt, originalDays, openingEvidence and related lifecycle timestamps independently require their source capabilities; an Order timestamp is never a public Position fact by default.

RangeEvaluation.description: Verified strike geometry, not breakeven or general trading preference.

ManualCheckpoint.description: Verified target+GTD convention; neither notification nor automatic close is established.

ManagementEvaluation.description: Does not impose Strategy or Regime. Current P/L and targets retain exact signed values beyond any terminal viewport. Missing stop never becomes theoretical max loss; no protective stop requires positively complete reconciled Order evidence.

ExactNumber.description: Exact coordinate or affine coefficient; rational form permits nonterminating decimal roots.

AffineSegment.description: y = slope*S + intercept on [lower,upper); null upper means +infinity. S>=0. Continuous shared endpoints have equal values; exact boundary values below remove endpoint ambiguity.

displayPoints.description: Optional backend samples of the exact supplied affine geometry over a display viewport, including sloping tails. Presentation padding is not a risk threshold. Clients scale pixels, never infer financial endpoint values. Same valueKind and units as geometry.

financialReference.description: Candidate conditional expiration reference using exact whole retained broker-reported basis. Excludes prior calls, distributions and future costs; does not establish attributed opening or lifecycle P/L.

financialRegions.description: Backend zero-closed polygons from the same qualified P/L affine function; clients scale pixels only. Absent for contractual terminal value.

breakEvenMarkers.description: Backend display coordinates and labels of exact breakEvenPrices. Nonterminating rational roots have approximate decimal coordinates and an explicitly approximate rounded label; exact financial roots remain separately available. Clients do not divide or reconstruct financial roots.

Geometry.description: Backend-provided exact aggregate function, including unequal tails. Slopes have valueCurrency per unit of underlying price; intercepts/value use valueCurrency. No loss of geometry to CLI glyphs. Does not describe an executable closing price or early-exercise path.

EconomicPeriod.description: Historical loss floor is not current protection. Long call rights do not establish current share ownership.

CumulativeEconomics.description: Separate documented cash-flow sums from realized P/L and remaining open proceeds. Missing history makes full cumulative result incomplete; documented subtotals may remain QUALIFIED. Economic break-even is not tax basis. No implied strategy or share-selection engine.

EconomicComparison.description: Optional detailed Position comparison, reusing immutable Construction history and reported Orders/Transactions. No separate resource, strategy identity or inferred execution events.
